target.title: fix(cron): preserve cron context in session entry for async completion wakes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99919

When a cron job uses an async media generation tool (`image_generate`, `video_generate`, `music_generate`), the cron run ends while the media task is still in progress. When the media task later completes and wakes the session, the resumed agent run **loses the original cron context**:

- `provider` / `model` — falls back to account defaults instead of the cron's configured model
- `thinkLevel` — not restored
- `bootstrapContextRunKind` — missing; the resumed agent doesn't know it is a cron run

The agent wakes up, sees only "image done" with no memory of the original multi-step task (build → commit → deploy → notify), replies once, and ends. The remaining steps silently dead-end with `NO_REPLY`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix has two parts connected through the session store:

**1. Persist** — When a cron agent run completes, write `bootstrapContextRunKind` onto the `SessionEntry` in the session store (`agent-command.ts`). This makes the cron origin discoverable by any later run on the same session key.

**2. Restore** — In `sendSubagentAnnounceDirectly`, when building the `directAgentParams` for an async completion wake, read `requesterEntry.bootstrapContextRunKind` from the loaded session entry. If it equals `"cron"`, inject `provider`, `model`, `thinkLevel`, and `bootstrapContextRunKind` into the wake params so the resumed agent continues with the same identity.

**Safety**: Only cron session entries carry `bootstrapContextRunKind: "cron"`. Subagent session entries (`agent:<id>:subagent:<uuid>`) never have this field, so subagent-to-subagent completion paths are completely unaffected.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Cron jobs using async media generation silently lost context on wake. The resumed agent had the wrong model and no memory of the task, causing multi-step jobs to dead-end after the first async call.
- **After**: Async completion wakes restore the cron's provider, model, thinking level, and run kind from the persisted session entry. The agent continues the original task instead of falling back to account defaults.

## Evidence

### Tests

```bash
# Targeted tests
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts
# → 114/114 passed (includes 2 new tests for #99919)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/
# → 1277/1277 passed (119 test files)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.async-tasks.test.ts
# → 8/8 passed

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagent-announce.test.ts
# → 14/14 passed

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-command.ingress-diagnostics.test.ts \
  src/agents/agent-command.compaction-rotation.test.ts \
  src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts
# → 204/204 passed (4 test files)
```

### Lint

```bash
node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet \
  src/agents/agent-command.ts \
  src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.ts \
  src/config/sessions/types.ts \
  src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts
# → clean (exit 0)
```

### Review

```bash
.claude/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main \
  --engine claude --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --thinking medium
# → autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
# → overall: patch is correct (0.95)
```

### What was tested live

- All 114 subagent-announce-delivery tests pass, including 2 new tests specifically covering:
  - ✅ Cron session wake injects provider, model, thinkLevel, bootstrapContextRunKind
  - ✅ Non-cron session wake does NOT inject these fields (subagent safety)
- All 1277 cron tests pass unchanged
- Full lint (oxlint) pass on all changed files
- Claude Sonnet 4.6 autoreview clean (no findings)

### What was not tested live

- A real cron + async image_generate round-trip requires a Codex app-server environment and is deferred to Testbox/Crabbox proof. The code-level integration tests cover the exact dispatch path (session entry → `sendSubagentAnnounceDirectly` → `directAgentParams`) with mocked session store.
